Privacy Policy

How the site handles data, cookies, and third-party services.

Data Collection: This platform does not sell personal information and does not require account registration. It asks for information in two places only: the optional Questions or feedback form, a Google Form. It records what you type, the page you sent it from, the role you pick, and an email address only if you choose to give one. Responses are kept in a private spreadsheet read by the site's maintainers and are not published or shared. Google's privacy policy applies to the form. The second is email: a message sent to info@cohoanalytics.com is passed on by an email-forwarding service to the maintainers' private mailbox, where your address and what you wrote are kept. Emails are not published or shared.

Analytics & Tracking: This site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits. It sets no cookies, does not fingerprint your browser, and does not track you across sites; it records only anonymous page views, the referring site, and coarse browser, device and country information. Developer pages are not measured. No advertising trackers are used. See the Cloudflare Privacy Policy for how Cloudflare handles this data.

Cookies: This site uses only functional cookies necessary for features such as dark-mode preference persistence. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are set. You may clear cookies at any time through your browser settings without affecting access to site content.

Third-Party Services: Data displayed on this platform is retrieved from public APIs operated by third parties, including the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), the U.S. Census Bureau, the Bureau of Labor Statistics, HUD, CHFA (Colorado Housing and Finance Authority) via ArcGIS, and Esri/ArcGIS mapping services. When your browser fetches data directly from these services, those providers' own privacy policies apply. This site does not control and is not responsible for their data practices.

Map Tiles: Interactive maps are rendered using Leaflet with basemap tiles that may be served by OpenStreetMap contributors or other tile providers. Tile requests may log your IP address per those providers' standard server logs. See OpenStreetMap Foundation Privacy Policy for details.

External Links: This site links to external government and industry resources. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those external sites. Links are provided for reference only and do not constitute endorsement.

Data Retention: Apart from messages you send through the feedback form or by email, the site keeps no user data. Form responses (in the private spreadsheet) and emails (in the maintainers' mailbox) are kept while they are useful for answering you or fixing the site, and are deleted on request. Cached public datasets (e.g., data/fred-data.json) contain only aggregated economic series with no personal information.

Your Rights: To have a feedback message or email you sent corrected or deleted, ask through the same form or at info@cohoanalytics.com, and include the email address you used. If you believe any content on this platform violates your rights or contains inaccurate information about you, please contact us.

Contact: Privacy questions or concerns may be sent through the Questions or feedback form or by email to info@cohoanalytics.com.

Policy Updates: This privacy policy may be updated as site features evolve. The most current version is always available on this page.

Free, and worth every penny. COHO Analytics is offered as-is, with no warranty. It isn’t legal, tax or financial advice, and pggLLC isn’t liable for what you do with it. Using the site means you accept the terms.
